channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: ‘Claude resented me for ghosting’: Deepinder Goyal reveals why he built privacy-first AI assistant Dark.ai
item.description: Deepinder Goyal explained that Dark.ai is being developed around a central promise of privacy-by-design.

item.title: Carlsberg prepares India business IPO worth up to $700 million, eyes December launch
item.description: Carlsberg A/S is preparing to publicly file documents for an initial public offering of its India business, which could raise as much as $700 million, as early as this week, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Meta’s share deal with Zuckerberg aims to cover potential multibillion-dollar wealth tax bill: How it works
item.description: Meta has agreed to keep CEO Mark Zuckerberg in California for eight years as the state considers a proposed one-time 5% tax on billionaires. A new class of nonvoting shares will let him raise cash while preserving his voting control and support Meta’s AI investment plans.

item.title: Anthropic opens ₹3.26 crore job for human writers; experts say it's a ‘premium on judgment’
item.description: Anthropic wants a candidate with at least eight years of experience who can quickly digest technical concepts, sharpen executive thinking, and maintain composure during breaking news.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion penalty: What's the data privacy case? Will it impact value of Zuckerberg's company?
item.description: The case stems from allegations that Cambridge Analytica, a British political consulting firm involved in Donald Trump's 2016 presidential campaign, obtained data from millions of Facebook users without their consent.

item.title: Ex-Brevan Howard Trader Sued by Quant Who Joined His New Fund
item.description: Ex-Brevan Howard Asset Management portfolio manager Robert Sicari was accused of withholding millions of dollars in promised trading profits from a former colleague who joined his new fund.

item.title: Ambani family hosts Marco Rubio and Sergio Gor at Jamnagar refinery; Reliance, US explore energy partnership
item.description: Reliance Industries Chairman Mukesh Ambani and Executive Director Anant Ambani hosted US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Ambassador Sergio Gor in Jamnagar. Here's what they discussed during the visit.

item.title: $30 million! Who is Zach Yadegari? Meet teenage founder - Know how he turned AI calorie tracking into a massive business
item.description: American entrepreneur Zach Yadegari co-founded Cal AI, a calorie-tracking app that reportedly generated more than $30 million in annual revenue before its acquisition by MyFitnessPal. Now, the 19-year-old founder is building Persona, an AI assistant startup that has raised $10 million.

item.title: L&T wins large orders worth ₹2,500-5,000 crore for Delhi Secretariat buildings, Andhra Pradesh office towers
item.description: L&amp;T has secured large construction orders worth ₹2,500-5,000 crore for two Central Secretariat buildings in New Delhi and two 47-storey office towers in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh. The projects are scheduled for completion within 24 and 30 months.

item.title: Who is Dhruv Toshniwal? The Pant Project raises ₹109 cr as menswear brand plans major retail expansion
item.description: Dhruv Toshniwal's The Pant Project has raised ₹109 crore in a Series B funding round led by Mirae Asset Venture Investments. The menswear brand plans to expand its stores, add new categories and strengthen its presence across India.

item.title: FSSAI issues notices to Nestlé India, Zydus Wellness over product claims
item.description: FSSAI has issued notices to Nestlé India over claims on Lactogen Pro 1 and Nan Excella Pro Stage 1, seeking scientific evidence. Zydus Wellness also received a notice over Complan, but said its claims are factual and backed by science.

item.title: Adani Green races ahead, but a sluggish grid isn't helping
item.description: Delays in grid capacity expansion meant that grid availability for Adani Green was less than 80% during the quarter and triggering production curtailment to keep the grid balanced.

item.title: Eternal revises Blinkit store target as Q2 net profit rises 92%
item.description: Blinkit’s quick-commerce margins improved for a sixth straight quarter, while Zomato sustained food-delivery growth through customer acquisition investments.

item.title: eBay layoffs: Online marketplace to cut 1,100 jobs as it reshapes operations
item.description: eBay will cut around 1,100 jobs, or 9% of its workforce, as it streamlines operations and focuses on fast-growing businesses. The move follows an 800-job reduction in February, while the company expands in luxury goods and resale markets.

item.title: Premji Invest, Norwest and Lok Capital back Vegafin’s majority stake in Bizloan with up to ₹1,000 crore in commitment
item.description: The capital will fund Vegafin's acquisition of a majority stake in Gurugram-based Bizloan and fuel the scale-up of its own AI-led, hybrid MSME lending platform.

item.title: TCS, Wipro turn to mid-market clients as AI erodes demand from large customers
item.description: TCS and Wipro join Accenture, Cognizant and HCLTech in sharpening their focus on mid-market clients. While Accenture, Cognizant and HCLTech have set up dedicated business units to target this segment, TCS and Wipro have so far only announced plans to step up their focus on such customers.

item.title: Essar Ports wins ₹2,276 crore Tuna Tekra terminal project in Gujarat
item.description: The project will be developed under a 30-year build-operate-transfer (BOT) concession through the public-private partnership (PPP) route

item.title: How Bajaj Consumer Care is defying an FMCG slowdown
item.description: Low-entry price points, a revamped direct distribution setup, and portfolio diversification are driving over 25% revenue growth for the hair oil maker even as sector peers grapple with muted volumes.

item.title: Who is KC Jhanwar? UltraTech Cement Managing Director appointed as non-executive Vice Chairman from January
item.description: UltraTech Cement Managing Director Kailash Chandra Jhanwar will become non-executive vice chairman on January 1, 2027, succeeding KK Maheshwari, who will step down. Jhanwar joined the Aditya Birla Group in 1981 as a Management Trainee in its cement business.

item.title: Indian Oil announces Subrat Kar's departure after 38 years: Here's a look at his career, achievements and more
item.description: Indian Oil announced Subrat Kar’s departure after 38 years. Its Executive Director (Planning and Economic Studies) held leadership roles in retail sales, international business and strategy, including heading IOC Middle East.

item.title: Micron reaches deal with Taiwan union amid bonus dispute; October 22 strike still looms
item.description: Micron reaches a labour agreement with its Taichung union in Taiwan as a separate Taoyuan union prepares for an October 22 strike over bonuses.

item.title: Scotch imports by Pernod Ricard, Diageo under tax probe - How is it linked to India-UK trade deal? All you need to know
item.description: India is investigating Pernod Ricard and Diageo over the classification of bulk Scotch imports for reduced tariffs under the India-UK trade deal. The companies also face scrutiny over alleged use of prohibited flavouring in some alcoholic drinks. Both say they are cooperating with authorities.

item.title: The LaLiT earmarks ₹600 crore for hotel expansion, to add 1,000 rooms in five years
item.description: Bhart Hotels Limited will split its upcoming 1,000-room inventory between owned properties and management contracts as it steps up expansion

item.title: Anthropic lost over $80 billion in first half of 2026, on track to spend $750 billion for computing capacity: Report
item.description: Anthropic reported a first-half net loss exceeding $80 billion, largely due to accounting charges, while revenue surged to $16.3 billion. The company also projected massive future spending on computing capacity, underscoring the high costs of the AI race.

item.title: L&T bets on five boards to keep growth humming
item.description: The company has set up five divisional boards to provide strategic advice to its numerous business divisions.

item.title: Who is Rahul Agarwal? Indian-origin inventor who secured a ₹3.3 crore deal on Shark Tank USA for reimagined spoons
item.description: Indian-origin inventor Rahul Agarwal secured a $350,000 deal from Lori Greiner and Mindy Kaling on Shark Tank USA for Polygons, his origami-inspired measuring spoons. The magnetic tools fold flat for storage and replace six conventional spoons with two, offering three measurements in a compact set.

item.title: Boeing 737 Max 10 wins FAA approval after years of delays, challenging Airbus A321neo
item.description: Boeing Co. won US regulator approval for its 737 Max 10 jet, capping off a lengthy certification saga for the planemaker’s family of narrowbody aircraft that was disrupted by two fatal crashes and a series of quality lapses.

item.title: ‘A good idea’: Elon Musk says special committees will discuss Tesla and SpaceX merger while he sits out
item.description: Tesla and SpaceX have formed independent special committees to consider a potential merger that could create a company valued at about $3.5 trillion. Elon Musk says he will not participate in committee discussions, and stressed that no deal has been agreed and a merger may never happen.

item.title: Iveco's minority shareholders emerge as key hurdle to Tata’s takeover bid
item.description: Tata Motors must secure silent shareholders vote to complete €3.9 billion Iveco acquisition.

item.title: Buoyed by blockbuster IPO, ESDS bets on AI chip rentals for $5 billion revenue scope in 5 years
item.description: In an interview with Mint, CMD Piyush Somani laid out an ambitious AI chip rental strategy to drive growth. But compounding revenue 2.5 times every year remains a rare feat, even in tech.

item.title: Match Group eyes India growth even as dating-app scams raise safety concerns
item.description: The Tinder owner says scams and fake accounts are among its most prominent user complaints, but does not disclose India-specific safety spending, scam reports or revenue

item.title: Ammonium nitrate to PETN: CCPA cracks down on 7 online platforms over explosive listings; 3,940 sellers delisted
item.description: The platforms named by the authority are IndiaMART, TradeIndia, Dial4Trade, Justdial, Sigma-Aldrich India, ExportersIndia and Ibuychemikals.

item.title: Closed College Campus in Boston Suburb to Sell for $21 Million
item.description: A Boston suburb’s housing authority is planning to buy the campus of Eastern Nazarene College, which closed last year, for $21 million.

item.title: Citi Mexico sees new opportunities with banks after Banamex split
item.description: CITI-MEXICO/:Citi Mexico sees new opportunities with banks after Banamex split

item.title: Instacart settles federal claims of discrimination against US-born job seekers
item.description: Instacart settles federal claims of discrimination against US-born job seekers
